notes: Spectators in hosted games: lobbies hold up to 16 people, and once both teams are full, new arrivals spectate. Spectate from the lobby, or switch mid-match from the menu.
Take an open seat mid-match: spectators can join any seat a bot is playing, including seats left by people who disconnected. Joining a match in progress lets you pick a team or keep watching.
Lowering the team size in the lobby moves the extra players to spectating instead of refusing.
Spectating on phones: touch controls for camera modes, targets and first person.
The main menu tells you when an update is out, and joining a game on a different version says who needs to update.
Fixed: errors when the window was resized after playing a match.
